# 闲退退出候选接口；只供可丢弃debug局，不负责卸职、付款、授品或皇帝审批。
# 人物作用域；TRAIT只允许两种现有探针特质。首次进入保存原超时与日期；
# 奉祠转致仕不覆盖原冷却快照，致仕不可转回奉祠。身份与超时桥接分别保存。
tca_retirement_candidate_enter_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            debug_only = yes is_alive = yes is_adult = yes
            NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_retired }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { tca_retirement_candidate_is_exited_trigger = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = tca_retirement_candidate_prior_timeout value = appointment_timeout_days }
            set_variable = { name = tca_retirement_candidate_entered_date value = current_date }
        }
        add_character_flag = tca_retirement_candidate_enabled
        remove_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci
        add_trait = $TRAIT$
        set_appointment_timeout = { years = 150 desc = appointment_timeout_desc_refusing }
    }
}

# 人物作用域；再次检查资格后才扣60影响力，恢复原冷却扣除实际经过日数的余额。
# 原生没有已确认的超时原因getter，因此这里只保存日数，不伪造原原因说明。
# 进入后新增合法冷却须由写入入口独立维护；此探针不宣称处理未知外部模组写入。
tca_retirement_candidate_resume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { debug_only = yes tca_retirement_candidate_can_resume_trigger = yes }
        set_variable = {
            name = tca_retirement_candidate_remaining_timeout
            value = {
                value = var:tca_retirement_candidate_prior_timeout
                subtract = { value = current_date subtract = var:tca_retirement_candidate_entered_date }
                min = 0
            }
        }
        change_influence = -60
        remove_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci
        clear_appointment_timeout = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:tca_retirement_candidate_remaining_timeout > 0 }
            set_appointment_timeout = { days = tca_retirement_candidate_remaining_timeout_days }
        }
        remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_remaining_timeout
        remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_prior_timeout
        remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_entered_date
        remove_character_flag = tca_retirement_candidate_enabled
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；仅清理本例创建人物的候选身份及快照，再走既有夹具清理。
tca_test_cleanup_retirement_exit_actor_effect = {
    remove_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci
    remove_trait = tca_retirement_probe_retired
    remove_character_flag = tca_retirement_candidate_enabled
    remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_prior_timeout
    remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_entered_date
    remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_remaining_timeout
    tca_test_cleanup_merit_probe_character_effect = yes
}

# 人物作用域；移除退休资格健康探针按实测偏移添加的外部健康补偿修正。
# 只含测试专用修正且逐项检查存在性，重复调用幂等，不触碰其它来源的修正。
tca_test_retirement_clear_health_compensation_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_001 } remove_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_001 }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_003 } remove_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_003 }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_005 } remove_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_005 }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_007 } remove_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_007 }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_010 } remove_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_010 }
}

# 报告者作用域；TITLE为真实目标头衔，CANDIDATE为该头衔初始current_heir快照。
# 原生重算后读取整个列表；不会指定继承人或以自造资格代替阳性对照。
tca_test_capture_retirement_heir_effect = {
    remove_character_flag = $FLAG$
    $TITLE$.holder = { scriptedtests_recalculate_succession = yes }
    $TITLE$ = {
        debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_PHASE title=[THIS.Title.GetKey]"
        holder = {
            debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_HOLDER id=[THIS.Char.GetID]"
            liege ?= { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_HOLDER_LIEGE id=[THIS.Char.GetID]" }
        }
        every_title_heir = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_MEMBER id=[THIS.Char.GetID] rank=[THIS.Char.GetMeritLevel] timeout=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_merit_diag_timeout_value')|0]" }
    }
    $CANDIDATE$ = {
        debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_CONTROL_STATE id=[THIS.Char.GetID] rank=[THIS.Char.GetMeritLevel] timeout=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_merit_diag_timeout_value')|0] influence=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_retirement_probe_influence_value')] influence_level=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_retirement_probe_influence_level_value')|0]"
        primary_title ?= { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_CONTROL_TITLE [THIS.Title.GetKey]" }
        liege_or_court_owner ?= { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_CONTROL_LIEGE id=[THIS.Char.GetID]" }
        if = { limit = { tca_retirement_candidate_is_exited_trigger = yes } debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_CONTROL EXITED" }
        if = { limit = { tca_retirement_excludes_appointment_trigger = yes } debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_CONTROL EXCLUDED" }
        if = { limit = { is_imprisoned = yes } debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_CONTROL IMPRISONED" }
        if = { limit = { tca_is_landless_official_trigger = yes } debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_CONTROL OFFICIAL" }
    }
    $TITLE$ = {
        every_title_heir = {
            if = { limit = { this = $CANDIDATE$ } scope:tca_re_reporter = { add_character_flag = $FLAG$ } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = $FLAG$ } }
        $TITLE$ = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_LIST_ABSENT title=[THIS.Title.GetKey]" }
        $CANDIDATE$ = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_LIST_CONTROL id=[THIS.Char.GetID] rank=[THIS.Char.GetMeritLevel] timeout=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_merit_diag_timeout_value')|0]" }
    }
}

tca_test_capture_retirement_heir_lists_effect = {
    tca_test_capture_retirement_heir_effect = { TITLE = scope:tca_re_local_title CANDIDATE = scope:tca_re_local_heir FLAG = tca_re_in_local_list }
    tca_test_capture_retirement_heir_effect = { TITLE = title:e_minister_of_justice CANDIDATE = scope:tca_re_ministry_heir FLAG = tca_re_in_ministry_list }
    tca_test_capture_retirement_heir_effect = { TITLE = scope:tca_re_tongpan_title CANDIDATE = scope:tca_re_tongpan_heir FLAG = tca_re_in_tongpan_list }
    tca_test_capture_retirement_heir_effect = { TITLE = scope:tca_re_judicial_title CANDIDATE = scope:tca_re_judicial_heir FLAG = tca_re_in_judicial_list }
}

# 报告者作用域；四个真实继任者可以是同一人物，每个动作均以人物借用旗标幂等。
tca_test_retirement_native_controls_effect = {
    scope:tca_re_local_heir = { $ACTION$ = yes }
    scope:tca_re_ministry_heir = { $ACTION$ = yes }
    scope:tca_re_tongpan_heir = { $ACTION$ = yes }
    scope:tca_re_judicial_heir = { $ACTION$ = yes }
}

# 仅借无候选临时状态的真实人物；不写家门、头衔、官品、Merit或正式退休离散标记。
# 保护特质用独立所有权，绝不撤回本例之前已存在的死亡保护。
tca_test_borrow_retirement_native_heir_effect = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed } }
        add_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed
        set_variable = { name = tca_re_native_original_timeout value = appointment_timeout_days }
        set_variable = { name = tca_re_native_borrowed_date value = current_date }
        set_variable = { name = tca_re_native_original_influence value = influence }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_test_death_protection } }
            add_character_flag = tca_re_native_owns_protection
            add_trait = tca_test_death_protection
        }
    }
}
# 借用人物在等待期间可能被自然任命写入5年冷却；首次名单核对前恢复借用时的0冷却。
# 只处理本例已借用且尚未进入退休身份的人物，归还时仍按原超时快照处理。
tca_test_refresh_retirement_native_borrow_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed NOT = { tca_retirement_candidate_is_exited_trigger = yes } }
        if = { limit = { appointment_timeout_days > 0 }
            debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_NATIVE_BORROW TIMEOUT_DRIFT id=[THIS.Char.GetID] days=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_merit_diag_timeout_value')|0]"
            clear_appointment_timeout = yes
        }
    }
}
tca_test_fengci_retirement_native_heir_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed NOT = { tca_retirement_candidate_is_exited_trigger = yes } }
        tca_retirement_candidate_enter_effect = { TRAIT = tca_retirement_probe_fengci }
    }
}
tca_test_resume_retirement_native_heir_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci }
        # 身份过滤回归不把真实候选的余额强行降至500；只补足实际起复所需费用。
        if = { limit = { influence < 60 } change_influence = { value = 60 subtract = influence } }
        tca_retirement_candidate_resume_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci } }
            # 本例只测身份退出/恢复，费用由独立正式用例验证；恢复借用输入以免改动原生排序因素。
            change_influence = { value = var:tca_re_native_original_influence subtract = influence }
        }
        # 原生通判候选可能在新一轮名单计算时重设5年冷却；本夹具进入前原冷却为0，
        # 起复对照必须恢复同一初始状态，而不是把测试注入的冷却当作业务结果。
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci } } clear_appointment_timeout = yes }
    }
}
tca_test_retire_retirement_native_heir_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_retired } }
        tca_retirement_candidate_enter_effect = { TRAIT = tca_retirement_probe_retired }
    }
}

# 仅恢复本例临时身份、保护、影响力快照和按真实经过日数递减的原超时。
# 不调用新建人物cleanup，不删任何家门、实职、考试、教育或正式官品状态。
tca_test_restore_retirement_native_heir_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed is_alive = yes }
        remove_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci
        remove_trait = tca_retirement_probe_retired
        remove_character_flag = tca_retirement_candidate_enabled
        remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_prior_timeout
        remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_entered_date
        remove_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_remaining_timeout
        clear_appointment_timeout = yes
        if = { limit = { tca_retirement_native_probe_remaining_timeout_days > 0 }
            set_appointment_timeout = { days = tca_retirement_native_probe_remaining_timeout_days }
        }
        change_influence = { value = var:tca_re_native_original_influence subtract = influence }
        if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_owns_protection }
            remove_trait = tca_test_death_protection
            remove_character_flag = tca_re_native_owns_protection
        }
        remove_variable = tca_re_native_original_timeout
        remove_variable = tca_re_native_borrowed_date
        remove_variable = tca_re_native_original_influence
        remove_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed
    }
}

# 只保留初始真实目标与控制者摘要，不逐成员输出整张继承表。
# 初始控制必须在原生重算后冻结，防止缓存中的冷却人物成为假阳性。
tca_test_dump_retirement_native_heirs_effect = {
    $TITLE$ = {
        debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_HEIR_TARGET $LABEL$ title=[THIS.Title.GetKey]"
        current_heir ?= { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_HEIR_CONTROL $LABEL$ id=[THIS.Char.GetID] rank=[THIS.Char.GetMeritLevel] timeout=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_merit_diag_timeout_value')|0]" }
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；为本地原生名单挑选真实天朝王级任官头衔，并冻结其原生继任者。
# 优先k_xichuan；若该头衔当前原生任官名单为空（例如刚经原生任命、候选整体冷却），
# 改选另一名满足相同条件的真实天朝王级任官头衔，仍只从原生名单冻结控制，不指定继承人。
# 候选头衔必须是无地类型之外、且持有人在原生任官继任法下的王级头衔，避免抽到无任官法的假阴性。
tca_test_pick_retirement_local_title_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = tca_re_local_title
    clear_saved_scope = tca_re_local_heir
    if = { limit = { exists = title:k_xichuan.holder title:k_xichuan.holder = { is_landed = yes government_has_flag = government_is_celestial highest_held_title_tier = tier_kingdom top_liege = root } }
        title:k_xichuan.holder = { scriptedtests_recalculate_succession = yes }
        title:k_xichuan = { if = { limit = { holder ?= { has_realm_law_flag = appointment_type_succession } } save_scope_as = tca_re_local_title } }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:tca_re_local_title }
        tca_test_pick_retirement_native_heir_effect = { TITLE = scope:tca_re_local_title OUT = tca_re_local_heir }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:tca_re_local_heir } }
            debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT LOCAL_LIST_FALLBACK title=k_xichuan"
            clear_saved_scope = tca_re_local_title
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:tca_re_local_title } }
        root = { every_vassal = {
            limit = {
                is_landed = yes government_has_flag = government_is_celestial highest_held_title_tier = tier_kingdom top_liege = root
                primary_title = { is_landless_type_title = no }
                primary_title = { holder ?= { has_realm_law_flag = appointment_type_succession } }
            }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:tca_re_local_title } }
                primary_title.holder = { scriptedtests_recalculate_succession = yes }
                primary_title = { save_scope_as = tca_re_local_title }
                tca_test_pick_retirement_native_heir_effect = { TITLE = scope:tca_re_local_title OUT = tca_re_local_heir }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:tca_re_local_heir } } clear_saved_scope = tca_re_local_title }
                else = { scope:tca_re_local_title = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT LOCAL_TITLE_FALLBACK title=[THIS.Title.GetKey]" } }
            }
        } }
    }
}

# TITLE / OUT；从原生任官名单冻结一名真实合格继任者，不指定具体人物。
# 优先使用名单成员而非可能陈旧的current_heir缓存；仍由调用者做完整资格前置检查。
# 选取条件与 tca_retirement_exit_test_events.txt `.4000` 的组合前置保持一致，
# 额外排除已带退休候选残留状态的人物：否则每次遍历覆盖 saved scope 后，最终
# 选中的人物可能满足不了断言，前置失败却看不出是哪一项。
tca_test_pick_retirement_native_heir_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = $OUT$
    $TITLE$ = {
        every_title_heir = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_alive = yes is_adult = yes is_incapable = no health >= 1.2 appointment_timeout_days = 0
                    NOT = { tca_is_landless_official_trigger = yes }
                    NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci }
                    NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_retired }
                    NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_retirement_candidate_enabled }
                    NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed }
                    NOT = { has_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_prior_timeout }
                    NOT = { has_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_entered_date }
                    this != root
                    NOT = { this = $TITLE$.holder }
                    NOT = { this = $TITLE$.holder.liege }
                }
                save_scope_as = $OUT$
            }
        }
    }
}

# 报告者作用域；只读诊断 `.4000` 组合前置的失败分量，不改变断言与统计。
# CHARACTER 为已冻结的原生继任者（可能未设置），TITLE 为来源头衔，LABEL 为日志标签。
# 正常时只输出一行 PICKED 摘要；失败时输出对应分量，便于从同次 debug.log 归因。
tca_test_diag_retirement_native_heir_effect = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = $CHARACTER$ } }
        if = { limit = { exists = $TITLE$ }
            $TITLE$ = {
                debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ PICK_ABSENT title=[THIS.Title.GetKey]"
                current_heir ?= { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ CURRENT_HEIR id=[THIS.Char.GetID]" }
                if = { limit = { holder ?= { has_realm_law_flag = appointment_type_succession } }
                    holder ?= { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ APPOINTMENT_LAW_OK holder=[THIS.Char.GetID]" }
                }
                else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ NO_APPOINTMENT_LAW" }
            }
        }
        else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ TITLE_ABSENT" }
    }
    else = { $CHARACTER$ = {
        debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ PICKED id=[THIS.Char.GetID] rank=[THIS.Char.GetMeritLevel]"
        if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL IS_DEAD" }
        if = { limit = { is_adult = yes } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL NOT_ADULT" }
        if = { limit = { is_incapable = no } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL INCAPABLE" }
        if = { limit = { health >= 1.2 } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL LOW_HEALTH" }
        if = { limit = { appointment_timeout_days = 0 } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL APPOINTMENT_TIMEOUT" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { tca_is_landless_official_trigger = yes } } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL LANDLESS_OFFICIAL" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci } } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL FENGCI_TRAIT" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_retired } } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL RETIRED_TRAIT" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_retirement_candidate_enabled } } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL CANDIDATE_ENABLED" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_re_native_borrowed } } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL NATIVE_BORROWED" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_prior_timeout } } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL PRIOR_TIMEOUT_VAR" }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tca_retirement_candidate_entered_date } } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL ENTERED_DATE_VAR" }
        if = { limit = { this != root } } else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL IS_ROOT" }
        if = { limit = { exists = $TITLE$ }
            # 前置要求 picked 不等于目标头衔的现任或其领主；命中才记录失败分量。
            if = { limit = { this = $TITLE$.holder } debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL IS_TARGET_HOLDER" }
            if = { limit = { this = $TITLE$.holder.liege } debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL IS_TARGET_HOLDER_LIEGE" }
        }
        else = { debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_EXIT_DIAG $LABEL$ FAIL TITLE_GONE" }
    } }
}

# 新建健康／压力人物作用域；调用者提供tca_rh_host。只隔离原生离庭、邀请和议会招聘，
# 不改变健康、压力、年龄、身份或候选起复资格。用例结束释放本项新增的邀请／离庭状态。
tca_test_lock_retirement_health_court_effect = {
    add_character_flag = blocked_from_leaving
    set_variable = { name = invite_to_court_cooldown value = yes days = 100 }
    set_variable = { name = block_hire_councillor value = scope:tca_rh_host days = 100 }
}
# 失败时只读输出真实衍生值和环境；不搬回宫廷、不修健康或重试断言。
tca_test_diag_retirement_stress_health_effect = {
    debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_VALUES id=[THIS.Char.GetID] health=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_retirement_probe_health_value')] stress=[THIS.Char.MakeScope.ScriptValue('tca_retirement_probe_stress_value')]"
    liege_or_court_owner ?= { debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_COURT actual=[THIS.Char.GetID]" }
    scope:tca_rh_host = { debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_COURT expected=[THIS.Char.GetID]" }
    if = { limit = { has_trait = tca_test_death_protection } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH PROTECTED" }
    else = { debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH UNPROTECTED" }
    if = { limit = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_fengci } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH FENGCI" }
    if = { limit = { has_trait = tca_retirement_probe_retired } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH RETIRED" }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_001 } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH MINUS_001" }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_003 } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH MINUS_003" }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_005 } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH MINUS_005" }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_007 } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH MINUS_007" }
    if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = tca_retirement_test_health_minus_010 } debug_log = "TCA_RH_STRESS_HEALTH MINUS_010" }
}
